Privacy policy

Last updated: 30 September 2026

This is a concept preview. It does not accept orders, bookings, customer account registrations, or personal information through forms.

Information handled by this page

The site has no customer account, checkout, contact form, analytics, advertising code, third-party font service, or embedded social media. The homepage removes old Kasuwa Moto demo cart and order records from browser storage when possible. On Vercel, the owner catalogue editor is protected by HTTP Basic Authentication. The browser sends the owner's credentials over HTTPS to a Vercel function for comparison with secret environment variables; this app does not store or log those credentials. The editor handles listing text and optional photos in the owner's browser memory; it does not upload them or save them in browser storage. Photos are resized and re-encoded before they are included in a downloaded catalogue file.

The owner must download and deploy the catalogue file to publish it. Once published, listing details and photos are public. Do not include personal or confidential information in listings.

Vercel, as the hosting provider, may receive technical connection data such as an IP address and requested URL to deliver and secure the site. Review Vercel's current privacy and retention practices and identify relevant processing before collecting customer data or launching a commercial service.

Choices and requests

This preview has no customer data account or contact channel for privacy requests. Before launch, the operating business should publish its legal identity and contact details, purposes and lawful bases, retention periods, service providers, data subject rights, and a way to submit requests.

Future changes

If the site starts collecting personal data or uses analytics, advertising, or other tracking technologies, this notice must be updated before those features are enabled. Review the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and obtain advice for the actual service and data flows.
